\label{lemma-A}
In Situation \ref{situation-compare} for $X$ in $\mathcal{C}$
denote $\mathcal{A}_X$
the objects of $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal{C}_\tau/X)$ of the form
$\epsilon_X^{-1}\mathcal{F}'$ with $\mathcal{F}'$ in $\mathcal{A}'_X$.
Then
\begin{enumerate}
\item for $\mathcal{F}$ in $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal{C}_\tau/X)$
we have $\mathcal{F} \in \mathcal{A}_X \Leftrightarrow
\epsilon_{X, *}\mathcal{F} \in \mathcal{A}'_X$, and
\item $f_\tau^{-1}$ sends $\mathcal{A}_Y$ into $\mathcal{A}_X$
for any morphism $f : X \to Y$ of $\mathcal{C}$.
\end{enumerate}

**Materialized Situation compare (sites-cohomology.tex:6840–6879).** Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with a finer site topology $\tau$ and coarser topology $\tau'$, so $\mathrm{Cov}_\tau\supseteq\mathrm{Cov}_{\tau'}$; the identity induces $\epsilon:\mathcal C_\tau\to\mathcal C_{\tau'}$ with exact inverse-image $\epsilon^{-1}$ (finer sheafification) and direct-image $\epsilon_*$ (the underlying sheaf). Let $\mathcal P\subseteq\mathrm{Arrows}(\mathcal C)$ and for each site object $X$ let $\mathcal A'_X$ be a **weak Serre** subcategory of abelian $\tau'$-sheaves on the slice $\mathcal C/X$. The following five *simultaneous* requirements define the named Situation: (1) $\mathcal P$ is closed under arbitrary base change by maps in $\mathcal C$; (2) for every $f:X\to Y$, restriction $f_{\tau'}^{-1}$ maps $\mathcal A'_Y$ into $\mathcal A'_X$; (3) each object of $\mathcal A'_X$ already satisfies the finer $\tau$-sheaf condition, i.e. is identified with $\epsilon_{X,*}\epsilon_X^{-1}\mathcal F'$; (4) for $f\in\mathcal P$ and $\mathcal F'\in\mathcal A'_X$, all $R^if_{\tau',*}\mathcal F'$ belong to $\mathcal A'_Y$; (5) every $\tau$-cover admits a refinement by a composite of a $\tau'$-cover, singleton $\tau$-covers by arrows in $\mathcal P$, and further $\tau'$-covers. For each $X$, define $\mathcal A_X$ to be the subcategory of abelian $\tau$-sheaves that arise as $\epsilon_X^{-1}\mathcal F'$ with $\mathcal F'\in\mathcal A'_X$.
